proposals.name: ZXD family (ZXDA/ZXDB/ZXDC)
proposals.def: X-linked ZXD-family C2H2 factors with a shared 10-finger architecture acting on MHC class II promoters (ZXDC partners CIITA). ZXDA, ZXDB, ZXDC.
proposals.why: Three close paralogues with a distinctive shared architecture and a common MHC-II promoter role; currently dissolved into the ZNF_OTHER catch-all.
